summary: Mobile App Testing - Critical Routing Issue Discovered. The /mobile-app route exists and the component works correctly when navigated to via JavaScript, but direct navigation via browser URL redirects to homepage. This is a critical blocker preventing comprehensive testing of all 30 mobile app features.

integration_issues.issue: Direct navigation to /mobile-app via browser URL redirects to homepage (/). The route is defined correctly in App.js (line 154-157) but React Router is not handling the navigation properly.
integration_issues.workaround: Manual JavaScript navigation (window.history.pushState + popstate event or window.location.href) successfully loads the mobile app
integration_issues.evidence: When navigating to https://ux-revival-1.preview.emergentagent.com/mobile-app, the URL changes to https://ux-revival-1.preview.emergentagent.com/ and shows desktop homepage instead of mobile app
